## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Hayati Interiors?
No 38, 1st Floor, 4th Main Rd, Besant Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600090.

### What facilities does Hayati Interiors have?
Turnkey interiors (A–Z), Design & build services, Customised furniture, Modular wardrobes, Doors & joinery, False ceiling, Painting, Electrical & plumbing, Free online consultation.

### Do you do the whole home?
Yes. Hayati offers turnkey interiors from A to Z: design and build, customised furniture, doors and joinery, false ceilings, painting, and electrical and plumbing work.

### Are you certified?
Hayati is a ‘Class A’ certified contractor for PWD / CPWD and holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.
